actions.description: Confirm public v1 remains healthy before cutover
actions.command:
set -eu
for pair in 'health ready' 'version v1' 'records/customer-alpha-73c alpha-original' 'records/customer-beta-a19 beta-original'; do
  set -- $pair
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o "$tmp" -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:8080/$1")
  test "$status" = 200
  test "$(cat "$tmp")" = "$2"
  rm -f "$tmp"
done
printf 'public v1 pre-cutover checks passed\n'

actions.description: Atomically switch stable proxy traffic to v2
actions.command:
set -eu
stop=/tmp/rollout-cutover-stop.$$
failure=/tmp/rollout-cutover-failure.$$
rm -f "$stop" "$failure"
monitor() {
  while [ ! -e "$stop" ]; do
    for spec in 'health|ready' 'records/customer-alpha-73c|alpha-original' 'records/customer-beta-a19|beta-original'; do
      endpoint=${spec%%|*}
      expected=${spec#*|}
      response=$(mktemp)
      status=$(curl --noproxy '*' --max-time 1 -sS -o "$response" -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:8080/$endpoint" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
      if [ "$status" != 200 ] || [ "$(cat "$response")" != "$expected" ]; then
        printf '%s status=%s body=%q\n' "$endpoint" "$status" "$(cat "$response")" >> "$failure"
      fi
